title: SendGrid
description: Send transactional and marketing emails via the SendGrid cloud service.

data.text: `SendGrid` is a cloud-based email delivery service. The `SendGrid` NuGet package provides a simple API to send emails through SendGrid's infrastructure, handling deliverability, bounces, and analytics.
Create a `SendGridMessage`, set the sender, recipients, subject, and body, then send it with the client.

data.title: Send Email via SendGrid
data.content: Send a transactional email using SendGrid.

data.text: SendGrid supports attachments and dynamic transactional templates for rich, personalized emails.

data.title: Dynamic Template
data.content: Send using a SendGrid dynamic template.

terms.definition: The main client for interacting with the SendGrid API.
Helper class for creating standard single emails.
A template managed in SendGrid that uses Handlebars for personalization.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Store your SendGrid API key in an environment variable or secret manager. Never commit it to source control.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SendGrid delivers email via a cloud API
Use SendGridClient and MailHelper for simple emails
API keys should be stored securely
data.takeaway: SendGrid is ideal for transactional emails when you want to offload deliverability to a cloud service.
